description: Cosmic Pixels is a team passionate about space, technology, and innovation. We welcome motivated teammates skilled in coding, design, research, and data analysis to collaborate and create meaningful solutions.
summary:
AstroCare is a browser-based astronaut health monitoring prototype developed by Team Cosmic Pixels for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

Long-duration space missions expose astronauts to physical, environmental, and psychological challenges. AstroCare addresses this challenge through a simple daily health check-in that allows users to record heart rate, body temperature, sleep duration, and mood.

The website provides a dashboard, health trend charts, a check-in history, and general health guidance to help users review changes over time. It also introduces important spaceflight hazards, including radiation, altered gravity, isolation, hostile environments, and distance from Earth.

AstroCare aims to encourage consistent health tracking and awareness during space missions. It is an educational prototype, not a medical device.
details:
AstroCare is developed using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. It is a responsive, browser-based prototype featuring a health dashboard, daily check-in form, interactive health trend chart, recent check-in history, health guidance, and space hazard awareness.

The prototype uses browser localStorage to save manually entered health information. It does not connect to real astronaut health sensors or provide medical diagnosis.

Team Cosmic Pixels developed this project to explore how simple digital tools can support astronaut health awareness during long-duration space missions.
